text: The gods, led by Indra, the seven sages, and the great sages, along with their retinues, proceeded to the mountain abode, as if undertaking a most auspicious beginning for the highest purpose. There, the Lord, seated on a mat, received all the offerings—precious gems, water for ablution, honey, and cow’s milk—brought in new garments and without a lower garment, all without any mantras.
